class.name: FoxShopSlot
class.brief_description: A UI component representing a single purchasable item.
class.description: Connects internal UI nodes to an item resource and visually updates based on affordability.

method.name: setup
method.description: Populates the internal UI nodes with data from the provided [param item_data].

method.name: set_affordability
method.description: Visually updates the slot based on the [param can_afford] state.

members.member: The core interactable [Button] the user presses to initiate a purchase.
The [TextureRect] used to display the item's icon.
The [Label] used to display the item's name.
The [Label] used to display the item's formatted cost string.
The [Label] used to display the item's description.
The [Color] applied when the item can be afforded.
The [Color] applied when the item cannot be afforded.
The [Color] applied to the [member cost_label] when the item can be afforded.
The [Color] applied to the [member cost_label] when the item cannot be afforded.
The data resource currently driving this slot's display.

signal.name: buy_button_pressed
signal.description: Emitted when the user presses the buy button.

signal.name: buy_button_focused
signal.description: Emitted when the user hovers or focuses the buy button.

signal.name: buy_button_unfocused
signal.description: Emitted when the user unhovers or unfocuses the buy button.
